properties.TITLE: Reversion to Acreage of TM 32-09, Alpine Vista Estates, Bridgeport (BOS Resolution R26-018)
properties.DOC_LINK: Res R26-018 Reversion to Acreage TM32-09.pdf
properties.NOTES: Adopted Feb 10, 2026. Reverts Alpine Vista Estates (TM 32-09, TMB 10/50, approved Aug 17, 1999; abandoned, improvements unfinished) to acreage. Owners to merge the 12 lots into 3 parcels (Exh. E); this abandons the offers of dedication.
